purpose: Prepare current sight and lighting before intermediate visibility, including stationary input steps that defer drawing.
review_state: native-gates-passed; actual paired Tiles performance and save-state acceptance pending

implementation.change: game::render_mid_step now calls map::build_map_cache for the observer level before map::update_visibility_cache.
implementation.trigger: A stationary observer remains in place while a terrain light is enabled or extinguished. Intermediate visibility previously consumed the previous lightmap; the next input frame prepared lighting and replaced that grid.
implementation.regression: Both light-on and light-off variants compare the complete prepared grid with a subsequent map/visibility refresh and its point query, while verifying the lightmap is clean and the observer position is unchanged.
implementation.ownership: Existing synchronous map cache preparation and visibility publication remain on the main thread; no new persistent cache, public contract or production worker.

source_explanation.prefix: do_turn.cpp sets each level lightmap dirty before input loop
source_explanation.suffix: update_map_memory prepares the map; suffix later invalidates visibility
source_explanation.mid_step: updates visibility using previous lm while dirty lightmap remains pending
source_explanation.input_redraw: game::draw prepares lightmap, invalidates and rebuilds the same 11 levels

source_diagnostic.evidence_kind: Counts and phase containment measured from accepted existing Tracy trace; dirty ordering inferred from native source and covered by the new stationary-light regression.

before_fix.meaning: The new regression linked to the preceding engine fails on the stale lightmap, unchanged brightness, mismatched full grid and point query in both variants.

tiles_build.configuration: existing Release SDL2 Tiles+sound, Lua Platform v1 ON, Tracy ON, TESTS OFF

focused_native_tests.scope: Map memory and map visibility cache regression tests, including the new stationary-light scenario. Dummy SDL drivers are used only by this native test gate, not for game performance measurement.
